prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Primary request: Create one refined image for the Ancient Wisdom Atlas recurring motif 'World Center'. A symbolic cross-cultural image for the motif 'World Center'. Core meaning: A place, tree, mountain, temple, city, altar, or body is imagined as the organizing center of the cosmos. Related symbolic ideas: sacred_tree_axis, cosmic_mountain. Traditions represented in the data: finnish_karelian, indigenous_australian, jewish_christian, norse. Show the motif as a universal symbolic scene, not as a literal collage of religions. Use layered archetypal imagery: ancient stone, luminous sky, ritual objects, threshold spaces, water, fire, trees, mountains, stars, veils, vessels, or paths only where they fit the motif. Make it contemplative, numinous, and scholarly: a sacred atlas plate that a mystic and a historian would both respect. No written words, no labels, no logos, no modern objects, no imitation of a living tradition's private ritual, no caricature, no gore.
Style/medium: museum-quality mythic concept art, illuminated manuscript texture blended with ancient fresco and subtle cinematic realism
Composition/framing: square atlas plate, central symbolic composition, balanced negative space, clear silhouette, no border text
Lighting/mood: numinous dawn-and-twilight glow, soft volumetric light, sacred but restrained
Color palette: deep lapis, warm gold, mineral red, bone white, charcoal, weathered stone; varied accents so the set is not one-note
Constraints: respectful cross-cultural symbolism; no text, no watermark, no logo, no modern typography, no specific copyrighted character
Avoid: new age poster cliches, neon fantasy excess, horror, gore, photoreal celebrity faces, random letters, illegible script, UI elements
revised_prompt: Illustrate a conceptual image on the theme of 'World Center' reflecting ancient wisdom. The scene should showcase universal, archetypal symbols such as an old stone structure or temple, a cosmic tree and mountain, set against a luminous sky. In the scene, include occasional ritual objects, water, fire, stars, and paths that correspond with the 'World Center' motif. The overall style should evoke a mythic concept art aesthetic, resembling the texture of an illuminated manuscript mixed with an ancient fresco, and a touch of cinematic realism. Compose the image with a square framing, a clear silhouette, and well balanced negative space. The lighting should give an aura of a sacred but restrained dawn-and-twilight glow with soft volumetric light. The color scheme should blend deep lapis, warm gold, mineral red, bone white, charcoal, and weathered stone with varied accents to avoid monotony. Keep the image free from text, watermarks, logos, modern typography, and specific copyrighted characters.
